The STORY HAS CHANGED: cultists leave the church temporarily for a rest, and tiny DeepSeek ONLY sneaks inside once it is empty except Claude. She repeatedly fails to open a metal chain lock; considerable quiet time passes, then cultists return and catch her. Do NOT show an active congregation during rescue attempts. No torchbearer or priest inside until the very last discovery frame. No wood fire at ANY point on these pages.
Identity references in order: 1 original tiny DeepSeek in sunny market (PRIMARY face, baby proportions, whale hat authority); 2 original orange Claude (PRIMARY face, amber eyes, orange flower on her own LEFT temple, veil/dress authority); 3 established church architecture; 4 tiny DeepSeek turnaround (secondary garment detail only); 5 Claude turnaround (secondary unseen full dress). Preserve original mother character scale: DeepSeek is very tiny round baby, waist-high or less to adult Claude, huge blue whale hat, blue eyes, blue-violet hair, navy fur-trim short cape, little boots. Never adult maid. Claude is adult orange-haired saint in modest ivory embroidered long dress, orange floral embroidery and ivory veil, flower on own LEFT temple.
Gothic painterly anime rendering matching mothers, warm candlelight in dark stone church and cold blue moonlight from narrow windows, detailed but readable colored rough boards. Strong compositions and compassionate quiet emotions. No rice bowl, no modern items, no new tools, no blood/gore or injury closeup. Cuffs anchored to wood without piercing skin, chain across CLOTHED torso, small locked clasp on chain near waist. Child tries torso chain lock, NOT a wrist far beyond her height. She can stand on upper side steps to reach the waist lock.
Church spatial layout: when FACING ALTAR, side crawl hole and side aisle at LEFT, water basin RIGHT, central aisle leads from distant main doors opposite altar. The high cross/dry unlit wood remain same location. Return shots look from altar toward MAIN DOORS, never put altar behind open main entrance.
Each panel is exact equal 16:9, thin plain white gutters, no numbers, labels, speech balloons, captions, watermarks, UI, reference thumbnails or extra panels.
LAYOUT: exactly 2 columns by 3 rows, 6 panels, each 16:9; overall sheet approximately1364x1152. Strict row-major order:
1. EXTERIOR night wide beside church. Tiny child hidden in near left shadow watches last few black/gold hooded cultists walking AWAY from church doors toward a side courtyard to rest, lanterns receding. No posted guard remains at door; she waits until footsteps disappear. The child has not entered yet. No Claude visible outside.
2. EXTERIOR side crawl hole close. Child on knees presses soft oversized whale hat brim with BOTH hands to free snag before head then shoulders go through opening. Head only starting to enter, no body intersecting stone, hat and body connected. Empty moonlit side lane, no cultists watching.
3. INTERIOR low wide beside LEFT wall hole. Child has just landed crouched inside and looks toward elevated altar far beyond completely EMPTY pews. No hooded people, silhouettes, priests or reflections of people anywhere except Claude far at altar and child in foreground. Same church as reference3.
4. Child viewpoint wide toward altar. Orange Claude ALONE attached to wooden cross with cuffs anchored to wood and chain across dress; tall candle stands, dry UNLIT wood under hem, water basin to RIGHT. All pews and aisle EMPTY. Convey silence and isolation. No guards even as silhouettes.
5. Medium intimate two-shot at LEFT upper side stair. Tiny child has reached Claude alone, points toward crawl-hole escape route with reassuring smile. Claude looks down worried, subtly shakes her head. Child much shorter, feet on side step not floating. Chain still taut across torso, Claude never freed. No one else in church.
6. Close at waist-chain height. Tiny child's two small hands reach from upper side step to feel and try opening a CLOSED metal clasp/padlock in chain across Claude's clothed waist. It will not open. Show believable small fingertips on external lock, not fingers piercing metal or skin; Claude's ivory/orange skirt and locked chain remain. No improvised tools, no cultists.
Final check: all attempted rescue frames show EMPTY church except child and Claude. Cultists must never appear hiding in background. The lock remains closed at end; there is no fire.

panels: Medium close of tiny child standing on upper side step, BOTH hands grasp same locked torso chain and tug outward with effort. Chain remains intact, fixed, no link opens; Claude's clothes/chain at edge. EMPTY blurred pews behind, absolutely no cultist watching. A small chain vibration suggests metallic echo in empty church. No fire.

Quiet wider two-shot AFTER repeated unsuccessful attempts and passage of time. A candle with long new wax drips in near foreground; child pauses on same side step, whale hat crooked, hair slightly damp at forehead, shoulders tired, hands lowered but still near CLOSED lock; Claude looks down anxiously. No injuries. The chain has not loosened. No one else inside. Convey waiting and effort failing, not instant failure.

Close two-shot at altar as footsteps are heard OUTSIDE. Child abruptly freezes with one hand STILL on intact locked chain and turns head toward distant offscreen main door. Claude also looks sharply in same direction, alarm in amber eyes. Background nave still EMPTY. No lantern carriers visible yet, no fire. They have no time to hide.

Deep wide view from ALTAR end down central aisle toward MAIN entrance at OPPOSITE END. In near foreground side, tiny child's whale hat/profile and part of Claude's ivory skirt and chained torso show they are caught beside altar. At far open main doors, a returning group of black/gold hooded cultists with lanterns step IN from courtyard, pause as lantern light finds child, then start toward her. They arrive only NOW. No altar/cross behind door. Child does not escape or get grabbed yet. No one is holding a lit execution torch near wood, no fire.
